name: Translate to Chinese (Traditional)
description: A voice speaks what you say in Chinese (Traditional). Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 134 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Chinese (Traditional) model from the Argos Translate package index: OPUS-MT (Tiedemann & Thottingal, 2020), CC BY 4.0. Voice: Piper voice zh_CN-huayan-medium (a Mandarin voice: it reads Traditional characters too) from rhasspy/piper-voices, see its model card.
